opportunities.title: TerminalFix Decoded: Fake Cloudflare CAPTCHAs, Weaponized PowerShell, and the Reverse Tunnel Microsoft Just Flagged

opportunities.title: Fire Ant: China's Cisco Router Hijack Isn't Just Espionage — It's Blinding Your Security Logs

opportunities.angle: Threat-actor profile: what Fire Ant targets, how it defeats detection, and a network-defender checklist for router log integrity

opportunities.title: Your AI Coding Assistant Is Now a Breach Vector: Anthropic's Infostealer Wave and the $600K METR Heist
